about_the_game:
Blackhall is a slow-burn psychological horror game set in an isolated underground shelter, its decaying passages and abandoned rooms echoing with the presence of those who once lived there. Explore the rotting carcass of a forgotten society, uncovering documents, recordings, and traces of lives long cut off from the outside world.

Blackhall takes place in the 1970s and lets you explore a remote underground shelter that became home to an isolated community. The facility, long abandoned and left to deteriorate, still shows traces of the people who lived there and the society they built. Investigate the remnants of daily life, from living quarters to power and water systems, and uncover the tensions, unrest, and isolation that defined the shelter’s final days.
